acquire: INSERT INTO leases (video_id, tenant_id, run_id, fence, expires_ms) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) + ?5 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM results WHERE tenant_id = ?2 AND video_id = ?1 AND fingerprint = ?6 AND revision IS NOT ?7) ON CONFLICT (video_id) DO UPDATE SET tenant_id = excluded.tenant_id, run_id = excluded.run_id, fence = excluded.fence, expires_ms = excluded.expires_ms WHERE leases.expires_ms <= CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) RETURNING expires_ms
renew: UPDATE leases SET expires_ms = CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) + ?5 WHERE video_id = ?1 AND tenant_id = ?2 AND run_id = ?3 AND fence = ?4 AND expires_ms > CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) RETURNING expires_ms
release: DELETE FROM leases WHERE video_id = ?1 AND tenant_id = ?2 AND run_id = ?3 AND fence = ?4 AND expires_ms > CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) RETURNING fence
stage: INSERT INTO staged (tenant_id, video_id, fingerprint, fence, payload) SELECT tenant_id, video_id, ?5, fence, ?6 FROM leases WHERE video_id = ?1 AND tenant_id = ?2 AND run_id = ?3 AND fence = ?4 AND expires_ms > CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, video_id, fingerprint, fence) DO UPDATE SET payload = staged.payload WHERE staged.payload = excluded.payload RETURNING fence
commit: INSERT INTO results (tenant_id, video_id, fingerprint, revision, status, payload) SELECT l.tenant_id, l.video_id, s.fingerprint, l.fence, ?6, ?7 FROM leases AS l JOIN staged AS s ON s.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND s.video_id = l.video_id AND s.fence = l.fence WHERE l.video_id = ?1 AND l.tenant_id = ?2 AND l.run_id = ?3 AND l.fence = ?4 AND s.fingerprint = ?5 AND l.expires_ms > CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, video_id, fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET revision = excluded.revision, status = excluded.status, payload = excluded.payload RETURNING revision
lookup: SELECT revision, status, payload FROM results WHERE tenant_id = ?1 AND video_id = ?2 AND fingerprint = ?3
lookup_answer: SELECT first_seen_ms FROM answers WHERE tenant_id = ?1 AND watchlist_id = ?2 AND video_id = ?3
record_answer: INSERT INTO answers (tenant_id, watchlist_id, video_id, first_seen_ms) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, watchlist_id, video_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING first_seen_ms
put_checkpoint_part: INSERT INTO checkpoint_parts (tenant_id, dataset_id, generation, part, payload) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)
publish_checkpoint: INSERT INTO checkpoints (tenant_id, dataset_id, generation, chunk_count) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, dataset_id) DO UPDATE SET previous_generation = checkpoints.generation, generation = excluded.generation, chunk_count = excluded.chunk_count RETURNING previous_generation
delete_checkpoint_parts: DELETE FROM checkpoint_parts WHERE tenant_id = ?1 AND dataset_id = ?2 AND generation = ?3
load_checkpoint: SELECT p.part, p.payload, c.chunk_count FROM checkpoints AS c JOIN checkpoint_parts AS p ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.dataset_id = c.dataset_id AND p.generation = c.generation WHERE c.tenant_id = ?1 AND c.dataset_id = ?2 ORDER BY p.part
